tasks.title: The tram
tasks.text: Trams appeared in big cities more than a hundred years ago. At first, passengers were afraid of the new electric cars, which moved without horses and made a strange humming sound. Within a few years, however, trams became one of the most popular forms of city transport. They were cheap, quiet and could carry hundreds of people at once. Today many cities are building new tram lines, because trams do not pollute the air and a modern tram can be as fast as a bus. For tourists, a ride on an old red tram is also a pleasant way to see the city.
